transcript.text: I have a blocking requirement. While load-testing an unrelated ingestion worker this morning, I confirmed that the queue service's standard mode can reorder report jobs during a broker failover. The provider's documented configuration requires FIFO mode and a maximum batch size of exactly 50 for ordered report delivery. I haven't updated the architecture draft yet, but the current draft uses standard queue mode with a max batch size of 200, which won't guarantee ordered report delivery.
